connector.name: Urlcheck MCP
connector.registryDescription: PreClick scans links for threats and confirms intent match with high accuracy before agents click.
connector.summary: Hosted at urlcheck.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.urlcheck. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
